vista.explicacion: The system gathers the photos you've uploaded with each mission and tells the story of your week. If you haven't uploaded any, there's no summary: an empty reel remembers nothing.
vista.montando: The system is putting your week together…
vista.notaMes: The system generates the monthly one on its own, on the 1st.
vista.vacioCuerpo: Upload a photo when you complete a mission and on Sunday you'll have something to look at.

pase.tocaSeguir: Tap on the right to continue

generar.sinPro: The coach puts the weekly reel together, and the coach is part of NIVL Pro. Your photos and saved memories are still here.
